vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: bats-core unit tests + docker compose integration tests

narrative.Overview: Implement the test suite: bats-core unit tests for shell scripts (bootstrap.sh and any utility scripts), docker compose integration tests asserting service health after stack start. Wires into Taskfile task check and CI. Depends on: bootstrap-entrypoint (for scripts to test), proxy-mode-stack (for integration targets).
narrative.Traces: FR-11 (bats-core unit tests + integration tests), NFR-3 (>=85% coverage for shell scripts)

items.title: Install and configure bats-core
items.description: Add bats-core as a git submodule or document installation in README. Create tests/unit/ directory. Add a Taskfile task (task test:unit) that runs bats tests/unit/. Ensure bats is available in CI (GitHub Actions step or Dockerfile for test runner).

items.title: bats unit tests for bootstrap.sh
items.description: Write tests/unit/bootstrap.bats covering: (1) wait-for-forgejo retries on non-200 response and succeeds when 200 returned; (2) admin creation is skipped when user already exists (mock Forgejo API); (3) token file is written correctly to /shared/forgejo-token; (4) script exits non-zero when GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD is empty. Use bats mocking patterns (stub curl/wget). Achieve >=85% line coverage of bootstrap.sh.

items.title: Integration test: standalone mode
items.description: Write tests/integration/standalone.sh (or .bats): starts docker compose up -d with a test .env (DOMAIN=localhost, Caddy internal TLS), waits up to 60s for Forgejo /api/v1/version to return HTTP 200, asserts the response contains a version field, then runs docker compose down. Test must be runnable via task test:integration. Clean up containers and volumes on exit (use trap for cleanup).

items.title: Integration test: proxy mode
items.description: Write tests/integration/proxy.sh: starts docker compose --profile proxy up -d, waits for Forgejo health + ghproxy :8080/healthz (or equivalent) to return 200, asserts ghproxy :9090/metrics is reachable, then tears down. Must not require real GitHub credentials — use GITHUB_TOKEN=fake and assert gitea-mirror starts without crashing (it may fail to mirror but must not exit 1 on startup).

items.title: Taskfile test tasks and CI wiring
items.description: Add to Taskfile: task test:unit (bats unit tests), task test:integration (standalone + proxy integration), task test (runs unit then integration), task check (fmt + lint + test). Add a GitHub Actions workflow file .github/workflows/ci.yml: runs on push/PR, installs bats-core and Docker Compose, runs task check.
